 Judgment

R.DEVDAS J., (ORAL):
This appeal is filed by the claimant seeking enhancement of the compensation awarded by the Second Additional Senior Civil Judge & Addl. MACT, Belagavi (for short 'the Tribunal') in M.V.C. No. 1480/2013.
2. During the course of these proceedings the appellant has filed I.A. No. 2/2015 for production of additional documents.

Learned counsel for the appellant submits that these documents are sought to be produced to establish the fact that subsequently, after the award was passed by the Tribunal,
the appellant has incurred additional medical expenses and in that regard various bills and other documents are sought to be produced.

3. In the considered opinion of this Court it would not be permissible to take on record the additional documents to consider as to whether the appellant would be entitled for additional award on the basis of the subsequent development and assess the award on the basis of the additional documents.
For that purpose the matter would have to be reconsidered by the Tribunal.
4. For the reasons stated above, the matter stands remanded back to the Tribunal for reconsideration while giving an opportunity to the appellant to furnish additional documents.
For that purpose the impugned award is also required to be set aside and is accordingly set aside.
The appellant is permitted to adduce additional evidence and seek appropriate compensation.
Needless to observe that full opportunity shall also be given to the respondent-Insurance Company to cross examine the witnesses and oppose the claim made by the appellant herein.
Ordered accordingly.
The trial Court records are directed to be forwarded to the Tribunal forthwith.

The parties are directed to appear before the Second Additional Senior Civil Judge & Addl. MACT,
Belagavi on 15.04.2023, without waiting for further notice.
